parsed.name: small_cap_catalyst_book
parsed.strategy: Bet on dated, primary-sourced catalysts inside a 126-session window: FDA PDUFAs from Nov 2026 to Feb 2027 in small/mid biotech where revision_flow_90d shows net raises, plus confirmed Oct earnings in semis (ASML, TSM, TER), gambling (EVO.ST) and defense (SAAB-B.ST). Small caps carry 18-35bp costs, so weights stay modest and cash is 6%. I would be wrong if a cluster of CRLs hits the biotech sleeve (rejections run 2-4x approval moves), if a hyperscaler capex digestion breaks the semis names, or if de-escalation compresses the defense and gambling catalysts.
parsed.objective: Maximise 126-session return vs SPY, net of costs, via dated small/mid-cap catalysts.
